summary: This is an 8-K filed by BurTech Acquisition Corp II, a blank-check company, reporting the consummation of its initial public offering (IPO) on May 26, 2026. The company sold 8,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, generating $80 million in gross proceeds. Each unit consists of one Class A ordinary share and one redeemable warrant exercisable at $11.50 per share. The filing also includes standard IPO-related agreements such as the underwriting agreement with D. Boral Capital, warrant agreement, letter agreement with the sponsor, investment management trust agreement, and registration rights agreement. No special-situation event is involved; this is a routine capital-raising transaction.
